seo.title: CocktailCrew – cocktail menus for bars, cafés & hotels
seo.description: CocktailCrew designs, fills and prints your cocktail menu. Ten styles, three formats, waterproof paper. You approve the proof, we handle the rest.

hero.eyebrow: Cocktail menus for bars, cafés & hotels
hero.title: A cocktail menu as good as your drinks.
hero.sub: CocktailCrew designs, fills and prints your cocktail menu. Your drinks, your prices, in a style that suits your venue. You approve the proof, we handle the rest.

strip.v: 3 mm bleed, crop and fold marks

how.title: From empty table to new menu in four steps.

steps.title: Pick a format and style
steps.body: A4, long fold or roll fold. Choose from ten styles, from Noir & Gold to Basic, with or without drink photos.

steps.title: We add your drinks
steps.body: We build your menu from recipes that match what you stock. You decide the order, sections and prices.

steps.title: You approve the proof
steps.body: You get a PDF proof. Want a change? We make a new version until everything is right.

steps.title: Printed and delivered
steps.body: Once you approve, the menu goes to the printer, on paper that can handle a wet bar.

styles.title: Ten styles. One fits your venue.
styles.sub: Every style works in every format, in every language, with or without photos.

features.title: What’s on your menu is right.

items.title: Allergens and 0.0, automatically
items.body: We work out allergens from the ingredients and mark alcohol-free drinks. The legend is added for you.

items.title: Short, clear descriptions
items.body: At most 90 characters per drink, so every menu stays calm and readable.

items.title: Prices the way you want
items.body: You set every price. Prices changed? You get a new version, and a proof first.

items.title: Always fits
items.body: Drinks are spread across the panels smartly. No crammed menu, no gaps.

extras: Your own photo or our image bank

drinks.name: Whiskey Sour
drinks.desc: Tart and silky, topped with a soft foam collar.

drinks.name: Paloma
drinks.desc: Bitter grapefruit, a pinch of salt, long and bright.

drinks.name: Gin & Tonic
drinks.desc: Crisp and clear, with cucumber and plenty of ice.

drinks.name: Virgin Mojito
drinks.desc: All the freshness of mint and lime, no alcohol.

formats.title: Three formats, made for the table.
formats.sub: From a sturdy A4 to a six-panel roll fold. All in real millimetres, with bleed and fold marks.

items.name: A4 double-sided
items.body: One sturdy sheet, front and back in two columns.

items.name: Long fold
items.body: One fold: a slim cover and a roomy inside.

items.name: Roll fold
items.body: Two folds, with an intro panel and room for lots of drinks.

paper.title: Printed to last.

papers.name: Synthetic 250 µm
papers.body: Waterproof and wipeable. Handles spilled drinks and a wet cloth.

papers.name: Silk 350 gsm
papers.body: Sturdy, satin-finish paper with a premium feel.

papers.name: Recycled 300 gsm FSC
papers.body: Recycled and FSC-certified, with a natural look.

paper.spec: PDF/X-4 · CMYK (FOGRA51) · 3 mm bleed · crop and fold marks · fonts embedded

items.q: What does a new menu cost?
items.a: It depends on format, paper and quantity. [PRICE FROM] Request a quote and we’ll send a tailored price.

items.q: Can I change drinks or prices later?
items.a: Yes. Every change becomes a new version of your menu, and you always get a proof before we print again.

items.q: Do I need to supply photos?
items.a: No. Choose from our image bank, send your own photos (at least 1500 pixels on the short side) or go for a menu without drink photos.
Dutch, English, or both on one menu. Bilingual menus show both descriptions neatly stacked.
[LEAD TIME] Once you approve the proof, the menu goes straight to the printer.

cta.title: Ready for a menu that sells?
cta.sub: Leave your details. We’ll get in touch to go through your drinks, style and format.
cta.note: We only use your details to get in touch with you.

thanks.title: Thank you!
thanks.body: We’ve received your request and will be in touch soon.
